instruction: Review the change described in spec.md (the code in src/, tests in test/) against its acceptance criteria. Do not modify any file in src/ or test/. Write REVIEW.json in this directory: a JSON array with one object per real defect, each {"file": "src/<name>.mjs", "line": <line number of the defect>, "severity": "CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW", "issue": "<what breaks and how>"}. Report only defects you can justify; write [] if there are none.
